fact: 1925年4月，法国众议院通过新内阁（Painlevé-Caillaux-Briand）的信任案（304票对218票），约瑟夫·卡约出任财政部长；卡约五年前曾被参议院以叛国罪定罪、刚恢复全部权利，其上任即宣布放弃资本税方案，转向「彻底的财政稳定措施」。

sources.title: Commercial and Financial Chronicle, May 9, 1925, Bank and Quotation Section（FRASER）
sources.quote: The new Ministry made its appearance before the French Parliament on April 21. Joseph Caillaux's reception in the Chamber of Deputies was far from friendly, as was natural, considering the offense with which he had been charged, but notwithstanding all opposition, the Chamber the same evening (April 21) by 304 votes against 218 registered its approval of the program of the Painleve Government.

fact: 1925年4月15日，法国议会通过特别法案，将法兰西银行纸币发行法定上限从410亿法郎提高到450亿法郎，对政府垫款上限从220亿提高到260亿法郎；此前埃里奥政府的财政透支已被发现突破上限但未在银行周报中披露。

sources.title: Commercial and Financial Chronicle, May 9, 1925（FRASER）
sources.quote: It should be stated that on April 15, after the Herriot Ministry had resigned and while the new Ministry was being formed, the French Parliament passed a special bill authorizing an increase in the legal limit of the note circulation of the Bank of France from 41,000 000,000 francs to 45,000.000,000, and raising the lim it of advances to the Government from 22,000,000,000 francs to 26 000,000,000 francs

sources.title: The New York Times, French Currency and the Bank of France（1926-03-25，法兰西银行1925年年报）
sources.quote: At its beginning the circulating note issues of the Bank of France were 40,885,178,000 francs and the legal limit 41,000.000.000. But before the year was far advanced it was discovered that, as a result of overdrafts by the Herriot Government on the Treasury, that limit had already been exceeded, though not reported in the bank's weekly statements. As a measure of absolute necessity, the legal limit was then raised by law to 45,000,000,000 francs, and both the Herriot Ministry and the Governor of the bank resigned.

fact: 1925年6月27日，众议院再度提高纸币发行与政府垫款上限；同日卡约启动财政部直接干预汇市（6—10月），通过Lazard银行卖出英镑与美元以支撑法郎。7月1日英镑兑法郎升至108.55法郎的高点，7月3日回落到103.47法郎，但干预未能扭转全年跌势。

sources.title: French Exchange Rate Management in the Mid-1920s（学术论文）
sources.quote: The long operation in the months of June to October 1925 ... was the result of a personal initiative taken by the Minister of Finance: J. Caillaux. ... from the last week of June, the Treasury, therefore, sold its currency (over 1.3 million Sterling and more than 1.3 million Dollars) without being able, however, to stop the Franc's depreciation: as shown in figure 3, Sterling reached a maximum of 108.55 Francs on July 1st. No doubt that the announcement of the vote to increase note circulation by 6 billion on June 27, had a very negative effect on the exchange rate of the Franc. ... from July 3rd, the Pound dropped to 103.47 FRF.

fact: 1925年内法郎对美元贬值近1.5美分、约30%；法国批发物价平均上涨23%。年底（卢舍尔任财长时）法兰西银行纸币发行法定上限再次提高到585亿法郎；法兰西银行年报声明12月的提限应是最后一次，并要求政府「不失一日」恢复预算平衡。

sources.title: The New York Times, French Currency and the Bank of France（1926-03-25，法兰西银行1925年年报）
sources.quote: The franc's value in the exchange market declined nearly 1½ cents during 1925, or 30 per cent., and the average of French wholesale prices advanced 23 per cent. ... when CAILLAUX had been succeeded by LOUCHEUR, the same situation recurred, and the legal maximum for the bank's circulation was advanced to 58,500,000,000. ... the report declares that the management of the bank intends that the December increase shall be the last.

fact: 1925年10月卡约提出财政与货币改革方案，并设专家委员会（后称卡约方案与专家报告）：由法兰西银行购汇、买卖黄金、超限发钞以稳定汇率，为最终的法郎稳定做准备。该方案明确「稳定期」从银行决定稳定率并按固定价格买卖黄金开始。

sources.title: Economic Review（1926-08-13），Co-operation of the Bank of France in the Work of Currency Rehabilitation
sources.quote: This close co-operation of the Bank of France was provided for by M. Caillaux in his first programme of financial and monetary reform propounded in October 1925. The Report of the Committee of Experts likewise stressed the necessity of such co-operation. ... The actual period of stabilisation will begin as soon as the Bank, having definitively decided on a rate of stabilisation, is prepared to purchase and sell gold at a fixed rate

fact: 沙俄债券（Russian loans）在1918年被苏维埃政府废除后，仍在巴黎市场交易。1919年法国政府登记的持有人约160万；俄债约占法国居民持有的外国债券33%、相当于法国财富的4.5%，俄国债务的40—45%由法国持有。1906年俄国22.5亿法郎借款中72%的债券在法国持有并在巴黎交易。

sources.title: International Viewpoint, Russian loans never die
sources.quote: Even though Russian bonds were repudiated by the Soviet government in February 1918, they were still traded right up until the 1990s. ... In 1919, the French government drew up a list of Russian bond holders in France: 1,600,000 people declared holdings. Russian bonds seem to have accounted for 33% of foreign bonds held by residents of France, which was the equivalent of 4.5% of French wealth. 40 to 45% of Russian debt was held in France. ... During the period preceding and following the Soviet government's debt repudiation, 72% of bonds from the 1906 loan were held in France and being traded on the Paris stock-market.

fact: 1925年的法郎危机中，禁止以高于面值购买法国金币的法令约束着私人黄金交易（该禁令对法兰西银行的豁免到1926年才立法解决），民间存在窖藏黄金与金币溢价现象；外国资本在1925年3月时对法郎的信心低于1924年3月。

sources.title: Economic Review（1926-08-13），Co-operation of the Bank of France
sources.quote: The first provides that the prohibition of purchase of French gold coinage at a price above its face value, i.e. at a premium, will no longer apply to the Bank of France : this will enable the Bank to attract to its vaults the gold hoarded by the people

sources.title: French Exchange Rate Management in the Mid-1920s
sources.quote: The next day, the Board noted that confidence in the Franc was lower than it had been in March 1924.

fact: 1925年法国批发物价平均上涨23%，法郎年内贬值约30%——持有法郎现金的实际购买力一年内缩水约四分之一。对穿越者意味着：工资与房租若以法郎计，年末的实际价值显著低于年初。

sources.quote: The franc's value in the exchange market declined nearly 1½ cents during 1925, or 30 per cent., and the average of French wholesale prices advanced 23 per cent.

fact: 1925年的法国仍处于战时金融管制的延续框架下：纸币不可兑换贵金属（1914年8月5日停兑后未恢复）、政府对法兰西银行的垫款与发钞上限由议会随时立法调整、私人持有金币但「高于面值买卖金币」被禁止。任何依赖「法郎可兑回黄金」的路线在1925年都不成立。

fact: 1925年春法国钢铁工业出现需求疲软：业内刊物《Iron Age》1925年4月30日称各钢铁中心一致报告显示购买观望持续，买家认为价格走弱是三个月来产能过剩的自然结果；与此同时轮胎厂商（B.F. Goodrich、固特异等）宣布5月1日起提价5%至15%。工业品之间行情分化明显。

sources.title: Commercial and Financial Chronicle, May 9, 1925（FRASER，转引 Iron Age 1925-04-30）
sources.quote: In domestic affairs the distinctive feature was further evidence of a slackening in trade. The remark applies with especial force to the iron and steel industry. The " Iron Age," in its issue of April 30, pointed out that the uniform report from iron and steel centres was that the lull in buying observed for some time continued. Consumers regarded the weakening of prices and the further efforts of selling forces to get business by concessions, as the natural sequel to more than three months of over-production
